subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: If a supported Google Chat DM-thread reply mechanism is proven, should each visible DM thread receive its own OpenClaw session or intentionally share the current space-scoped session?
rationale: This PR and the overlapping proposal encode different durable option names and conversation-memory semantics; source and API contracts cannot choose the intended product behavior.

options.title: Unify delivery and sessions
options.body: Use one opt-in setting that both replies in the originating thread and routes each thread to its own OpenClaw session.

options.title: Allow shared-session threads
options.body: Permit transport-only threading and explicitly document that separate visible threads share one conversation context.

options.title: Keep DMs unthreaded
options.body: Retain the current safe behavior if no supported API mechanism can be proven.

recommendation.title: Unify delivery and sessions
recommendation.body: Use one opt-in setting that both replies in the originating thread and routes each thread to its own OpenClaw session.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged history across the Google Chat sender and monitor, including the original thread-reply implementation.
